senses.definition: n.pr.loc. place where Benjamites dwelt Ne 11:34. 𝔊L Ναβαλατ. Mod. Beit Nebâlâ, 6 m. NE. from Lydda, according to Guérin Sam. ii. 67 f.; Mishn. בית נבלטא BuhlGes 12; Geogr. 197.
